name: JoAi: Create Site

description.en: Add a website record for the team. Pass a name; optional URL and type (undefined|shop). Slug is generated automatically.
description.de: Fügt einen Website-Eintrag für das Team hinzu. Name angeben; optional URL und Typ (undefined|shop). Der Slug wird automatisch erzeugt.

bot: Add a website with team + name. Optional url and type. type=shop requires url and marks this site as the post-checkout storefront return URL (one shop per team; brandless records only). Omit type or pass type=undefined for a normal website/portfolio record. Do not pass slug — it is generated from the name. Optionally pass contactId, metricsSource, metricsResource, and monthlyReport=true to opt into the 1st-of-month report job (does not send now). If enabling monthlyReport returns channel_not_configured for cloudflare, call settings-integration-open with integration=cloudflare, then retry. Use site-provision when the site should be live on a Warp brand.

description.en: Display name for the website. Slug is generated automatically.
description.de: Anzeigename der Website. Der Slug wird automatisch erzeugt.

description.en: Optional public website address. Required when type is shop.
description.de: Optionale öffentliche Website-Adresse. Pflicht bei Typ shop.

description.en: undefined = normal website/portfolio record (default). shop = storefront return URL after checkout (brandless records only).
description.de: undefined = normale Website/Portfolio (Standard). shop = Shop-URL nach Checkout (nur ohne Brand).

description.en: Metrics provider key (same as metrics-query source)
